notes.title: Getting Ready for the upcoming Playtest!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello![/b] [/p][p]I’m [b]Matzgo[/b], the developer behind [b][i]Siegebound[/i][/b], and I’ve got some exciting updates as we approach our first official playtest.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Finalizing Gameplay[/h3][p]I’ve been working on improving core gameplay systems — especially character and unit abilities, along with the buff/debuff mechanics.[/p][list][*][p]Buffs and debuff system (like stun, silence, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Creating a variety of abilities for a diverse set of units and buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing units and buildings to keep gameplay fair, but still exciting[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45533039/72cfdeb3680002bda1f39bf954f2c25dabcc062f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎶 Juicing Things Up[/h3][p]I’ve also been adding some much-needed [i]juice[/i] to the game. That means better feedback, more satisfying interactions, and just making everything feel a bit more alive.[/p][list][*][p]Overhauled sound effects using high-quality SFX assets[/p][/*][*][p]Added animations for the player character and game world interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Level-Ups and abilities now feel more impactful with improved visuals and audio[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45533039/18ba5ca7ce8d4c1746d9ac01347fa3712f697687.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 New Game Models & Textures[/h3][p]Now that most of the gameplay side is in place for the playtest, I’m focusing on visual improvements. Some things are still using placeholder models, so I’m cleaning those up.[/p][list][*][p]Creating proper models for key buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Developing an improved shader for buildings and units[/p][/*][*][p]Texturing assets to match the overall style of the game[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45533039/e9309bdbd103b02626b484f5c760ea467fc7d3f5.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📆 Playtest Info & What’s Next[/h3][p]I’m aiming for a [b]Steam playtest launch in the coming months[/b]. No exact date yet, but I’ll post another update as we get closer![/p][list][*][p]You’ll be able to [b]opt in directly on the Steam page[/b][/p][/*][*][p]A single level of [i]Siegebound[/i] offering a [b]unique[/b] [b]roguelike survival game[/b] with a large variety of units[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll have the opportunity to [b]help refine the game’s mechanics and build a better game together with me[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45533039/55b425c45431449ac35c2cffbf0dfc36be7cd0b9.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 [url="https://discord.gg/h3twMZkEju"]Join the community on Discord[/url] to chat, give feedback, or follow development![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for sticking around and following the journey.[/p][p]Can’t wait to share more with you soon![/p][p]— [i][b]Matzgo, [/b]Peasant Games[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/h3twMZkEju" style="button"]Discord[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@Peasant-Games" style="button" buttoncolor="#fb3737"]YouTube[/url][/p]
